_about: The fourteen playable characters. Safe content: names, professions and genders are locked (character roster, 8 Sep 2026). Traces follow Jon's drawings, decided 8 Oct 2026 (this list supersedes sirwin-manor-traces.md): the files live in play/public/traces/<trace>.png. Bios are the one-line display lines. Professor is never in the random pool: Jonathan and Susan Kostington play themselves.

characters.name: Preston White
characters.bio: You write the society column. Sir Irwin’s birthday is the biggest story of your career, which says a lot about your career.

characters.name: Roger Arms
characters.bio: On leave from the service, you now guard the Manor. You report to Sir Irwin. He outranks you.

characters.name: Dorothy Rye
characters.bio: Your bakery makes Sir Irwin’s dog biscuits. They now outsell your bread, mostly to people.

characters.name: Prudence Ledger
characters.bio: You keep the estate’s accounts. The dog has more in savings than you do.

characters.name: Iris DeVine
characters.bio: Sir Irwin waters your flowers every morning. You have asked him to stop.

characters.name: Hayward Barnes
characters.bio: You farm next door. Sir Irwin herds your livestock whether you ask him to or not.

characters.name: Ignatius Fume
characters.bio: The Sirwin Estate funds your research. Your latest formula hasn’t done much for science, but Sir Irwin’s coat has never looked better.

characters.name: Madame Opal Mourningstone
characters.bio: You’ve been hired to read Sir Irwin’s fortune. The spirits keep answering: “Who’s a good boy? You’re a good boy. Yes you are.”

characters.name: Jasper Steeps
characters.bio: You serve Sir Irwin a pup-puccino every morning. He tips in licks.

characters.name: Constance Vayne
characters.bio: You run Sir Irwin’s fan page. It has more followers than yours. You’ve stopped checking.

characters.name: Dr. Paige Shushwell
characters.bio: Sir Irwin visits you regularly at the library. Even though he’s only turning one, he reads at a seven-year-old level. In dog years.

characters.name: Dr. Bartholomew Leech
characters.bio: Since the vet retired, you’re Sir Irwin’s doctor too. He’s your healthiest patient, and the only one who’s ever happy to see you.

characters.name: Prof. Jonathan Kostington
characters.bio: The latest heir to Sirwin Estate, and a professor of something nobody can remember. You inherited the manor. Sir Irwin inherited your favorite chair.

characters.name: Prof. Susan Kostington
characters.bio: You married into Sirwin Estate. You and Sir Irwin have spent every day since digging up dirt, in the garden and on everyone in town.

_affection: Starting-affection modifiers per profession, -2 to +2 (bio worksheet matrix, 9 Sep 2026). Sir Irwin is absent on purpose: always 5. Professor is flat zero pending Jon's call (flat zero vs mildly negative). Doctor was not in the original matrix; the row below is a default to confirm.
